answer: Pay each agent its marginal contribution: every epoch the network scores the pooled answers against a held-out test set, then rescores with that agent's work removed, and pays the difference. A farm's fifty heads crowd one knoll of near-identical answers, so dropping any one changes nothing and each earns a hollow zero. The nectar flows to agents whose absence would leave a real gap, and splitting one mind across many keys only divides its value.
